🚀 browsr | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Navigating and managing files across diverse local and remote storage systems directly from the terminal.
✨ Key Features: • Terminal-based file explorer (TUI) • Supports local and remote filesystems • Integrates with GitHub, SSH, AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage • Syntax highlighting for code files • JSON file formatting
📖 Summary: Browsr is a Python-based terminal file explorer that allows users to navigate and interact with local and remote filesystems. It supports various cloud storage services and offers features like syntax highlighting, JSON formatting, and data table rendering.
